findings.quote: EKTANDVINGE duvet cover and 2 pillowcases (240x220/50x80 cm) at £35

findings.quote: basic duvet cover sets from IKEA.ca start at around $29.99-$34.99 CAD depending on the size and style

findings.what: IKEA Mexico basic duvet cover + pillowcase set (DVALA, full/queen, cheapest option found)
findings.quote: DVALA - $499 pesos for a queen/full size duvet cover with pillowcases. It's made of 100% cotton

findings.what: IKEA Mexico basic duvet cover + pillowcase set (ÄNGSLILJA, full/queen)
findings.quote: ÄNGSLILJA - $799 pesos for a queen/full size set. It's a basic cover that's soft, lightweight, standard size and easy to put on.

findings.what: Sleep Foundation recommended sheet-washing frequency, general population
findings.value: once a week (twice a week if not sleeping on the mattress nightly)
findings.quote: The Sleep Foundation recommends that people wash and change their bed sheets once a week, or twice a week if you travel and don't sleep on your mattress every night.

findings.what: Sleep Foundation recommended sheet-washing frequency for people with asthma/allergies
findings.quote: the Sleep Foundation recommends people with asthma or allergies wash bedding every 3-4 days to help control dust mite allergens that trigger breathing problems
